faqs.answer: An ophthalmologist like Dr. Dibya Prabha is a medical doctor (MBBS + MS) who can diagnose and treat all eye diseases, perform eye surgery, and prescribe medications. faqs.question: How often should I see an ophthalmologist?
faqs.answer: Adults should have a comprehensive eye exam every 1–2 years. People with diabetes, hypertension, a family history of eye disease, or those over 60 should have annual eye exams. Children should have their first eye exam by age 3–5 and then as recommended.

faqs.question: When should I see a retina specialist?
faqs.answer: You should see a retina specialist if you experience sudden floaters or flashes of light, a curtain-like shadow over your vision, distorted or wavy vision, sudden vision loss, or if you have diabetes and need a retinal exam. Also consult a retina specialist if your ophthalmologist detects retinal changes requiring specialist care.
